question: which accessibility cluster (ARIA remediation vs Focus management) raises the Accessibility criterion from 75 -> 90+ with the fewest new surface concepts, given the UX scoring matrix gap analysis?
summary: OSD nomination (2026-11-03): 2 candidates (A: ARIA remediation; B: Focus management). A ADOPTED for Phase 1 (weighted 4.2/5; targets screen-reader gap; additive attributes; low regression risk). B REJECTED for Phase 1 (3.6/5; behavioral focus changes; regression risk in drag-reorder + modals; core-flow accessibility gate already green). C (contrast) and D (screen-reader labels) dispositions recorded in the nomination, not in this 2-candidate OSD — C deferred to contrast track, D absorbed into A. Note: Phase 0 nomination later reconciled the spec's ~30-element estimate down to the measured surface.
decision_summary: ADOPTED: Candidate A (ARIA remediation) for Phase 1. REJECTED (Phase 1): Candidate B (Focus management). See evaluation_matrix.md and counterfactual_ledger.md.
